$comment: The site, on the apex domain. Static files only.
Set this Vercel project's Root Directory to apps/site.
`git.deploymentEnabled.main = false` disables Vercel's own git deploy for
main so .github/workflows/deploy.yml, which gates on the test suite, is
the only path to production. PR previews are unaffected.

headers.$comment: No backend, so connect-src is the site itself. The landing page's one module script and its media are same-origin files. 'unsafe-inline' in style-src is for style attributes that carry data as CSS custom properties (positions, stream geometry); scripts stay 'self' only.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; img-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; worker-src 'none'; connect-src 'self'

headers.$comment: Hashed asset filenames are immutable, so they can be cached forever. The HTML above them must not be, or a deploy is invisible until a cache expires.
